entries.name: Labour economics
entries.definition: The branch of economics that studies labour markets, wages, employment and unemployment.

entries.name: Labour law
entries.definition: The body of law governing the relationship between employers, employees and trade unions.

entries.name: LabVIEW
entries.definition: National Instruments' graphical programming environment, in which programs are built by wiring together icons, used for test, measurement and control.

entries.name: Land-atmosphere interactions
entries.definition: The study of how the land surface and the atmosphere exchange energy, water, carbon and momentum.

entries.name: Landing page optimization
entries.definition: Improving the design and content of web landing pages, often through testing, to raise the share of visitors who convert.

entries.name: Lando
entries.definition: A command-line tool, built on Docker, for creating and running local development environments.

entries.name: Landscape painting
entries.definition: Painting natural scenery such as hills, fields, water and sky.

entries.name: Landscaping and yard care
entries.definition: Designing, planting and maintaining gardens, lawns and other outdoor spaces around buildings.

entries.name: LangChain
entries.definition: A framework for composing language-model applications.

entries.name: Language interpretation and translation
entries.definition: Converting spoken (interpretation) or written (translation) content from one language into another.

entries.name: Language teaching
entries.definition: Teaching learners to understand, speak, read and write a language, usually one that is not their first.

entries.name: Large language models
entries.definition: Understanding and applying large models of language.

entries.name: Laser engineering
entries.definition: The engineering of lasers and laser-based systems, including their design, building and application.

entries.name: Laser level
entries.definition: A tool that projects a level or plumb line of laser light so that surfaces and fixtures can be aligned on a building site.

entries.name: Laser printing
entries.definition: Printing in which a laser draws an image onto a charged drum that picks up toner and transfers it to paper.

entries.name: Latin American and Latino studies
entries.definition: The interdisciplinary academic study of the history, cultures, politics and societies of Latin America and of Latino communities, especially in the United States.

entries.name: Law enforcement operations
entries.definition: Planning and carrying out the work of police and other law enforcement agencies.

entries.name: Law enforcement practices
entries.definition: The methods, procedures and rules that police and other law enforcement officers follow in their work.

entries.name: Lawful interception
entries.definition: The legally authorised interception of telephone and data communications by network operators for law enforcement and security agencies.

entries.name: LDRA Testbed
entries.definition: A software verification tool from LDRA that performs static and dynamic analysis and measures test coverage, mainly for safety-critical code.

entries.name: Lean principles
entries.definition: A set of principles, drawn from the Toyota Production System, for delivering value to customers while removing waste.

entries.name: Learner analysis
entries.definition: Studying the characteristics, prior knowledge and needs of the people who will take a course so that instruction can be fitted to them.

entries.name: Learner experience design
entries.definition: Designing learning experiences around the needs, motivations and context of learners, combining instructional design with user experience design.

entries.name: Learning agility
entries.definition: The capacity to learn quickly from experience and apply it in unfamiliar situations.

entries.name: LEGO Digital Designer
entries.definition: Free LEGO software for designing virtual models with digital bricks on a computer.

entries.name: Leisure education
entries.definition: Teaching people the attitudes, knowledge and skills they need to choose and enjoy leisure activities.

entries.name: Less.js
entries.definition: The JavaScript implementation of the Less compiler, which turns Less style sheets into CSS in the browser or in Node.js.

entries.name: Letterforms
entries.definition: The shapes of written or typeset letters, and the study and drawing of those shapes in lettering and type design.

entries.name: Levelator
entries.definition: A free desktop program that automatically evens out loudness differences in spoken-word audio recordings.

entries.name: Librarianship
entries.definition: The profession and discipline of organising, managing and providing access to library collections and information services.

entries.name: LIBSVM
entries.definition: An open-source library for training support vector machines for classification and regression.

entries.name: LiDAR
entries.definition: A remote sensing method that measures distances by timing reflected laser pulses, used to build detailed maps and 3D models.

entries.name: Life skills
entries.definition: Practical personal abilities, such as budgeting, cooking, time management and communication, needed to manage everyday life.

entries.name: Lightcast
entries.definition: A labor market analytics platform that provides job posting, skills and workforce data.

entries.name: LightGBM
entries.definition: A gradient boosting library for training fast decision-tree models on large datasets.

entries.name: Lighting design
entries.definition: Planning the type, placement and control of light for buildings, stages, films or other spaces.

entries.name: LightTools
entries.definition: Software for designing and analysing illumination optics such as lamps, light guides and displays.

entries.name: Linguistic morphology
entries.definition: The study of the internal structure of words and how they are formed from smaller meaningful parts.

entries.name: LinkedIn
entries.definition: A professional social networking platform used for networking, recruiting, job search and marketing.

entries.name: LinkedIn API
entries.definition: A set of web interfaces that lets applications access LinkedIn features and data, such as sign-in, sharing and marketing.
